## R Markdown


```{r data}
Anxiety_dec<- fread(file = "/Users/juanbalcazar/Downloads/Anxiety_Depression_META - Anxiety_decison_making.csv")

n_occur <- data.frame(table(Anxiety_dec$V5))

All_Duplicates <-
Anxiety_dec[Anxiety_dec$V5 %in% n_occur$Var1[n_occur$Freq > 1],]

#filter for observations > 1 and less than 9
SpecificDuplicates <-
n_occur %>% filter(Freq >1)


#new data yet to vet, check for duplicates
```
